messages:
emma: Quick kickoff  we need a messaging matrix + asset pack for launch week focused on benchmark narratives. Deliverables: CSV mapping CTA variant -> campaign tag -> nurture stream, 3 tiles (latency/cost/quality), 1x 16:9 explainer slide, Lottie microanimations (loop ~1.5s) for social, WebP + PNG exports, and an accessibility checklist. Mobile-first. Deadline: Thu EOD.
rachel: Can we also get a compact A/B test matrix for headline + CTA combos? Want control arms for copy and visual (color accent swap).
josh: I can generate headlines. Please confirm character limits for social cards (IG caption + twitter alt). Also, which locales?
emma: Localize FR/JA/ES. Social CTAs: keep <= 18 chars. Provide source strings in a CSV with context notes.
priya: Design asks: tokenized Figma file, separate text layer for copy, Lottie JSON + GIF fallback, WebP for socials, and an asset manifest listing filenames + intended channel. Will run AA contrast checks.
legal: Heads-up  no absolute comparative claims. Use qualifying language like "latency-optimized" or "cost-efficient." Any metric comparisons must have methodology citation and be labeled (p95/p50). We'll need final copy for signoff.
js: @josh please include the one-line methodology for footer: e.g., "p95 latency across standard gen workloads with default batching; cost normalized to baseline."
priya: Noted. Also including an accessibility checklist: alt text examples, color contrast pass/fail, keyboard focus order for interactive Lottie embeds, and recommended ARIA labels.
cs m: We'll need a CSM review for customer-facing claims. Please route final copy to @csm for approval before scheduling the webinar.
emma: For inbound routing CSV, include columns: asset_id, cta_variant, campaign_tag, nurture_stream, utm_source, utm_campaign. Keep CTA variants short.
rachel: For the A/B matrix, want trackable campaign tags: ab_headlineA, ab_headlineB, visual_accentA/B. Josh will draft copy by tomorrow noon.
josh: Drafting now. Example headline A: "Latency-optimized inference at scale" (will avoid "fastest"). Headline B: "Lower per-token cost for production". CTAs: "Register" / "Watch & Demo" / "Try Bench".
priya: I'll set up Figma starter file and tokens. Link: https://figma.com/file/launch-matrix-174999. Artboards: tiles, slide, lottie, icons, strings-csv. Exports: PNG 600x600, WebP social 1080x1080, slide 1920x1080, Lottie <1.5s, GIF fallback.\em a: Please include separate CSV of strings for FR/JA/ES and mark length constraints. Also include translator context for CTAs.
legal: Once copy is in place, send to legal channel; we'll review within 24 hrs if no major claims.
priya: First pass ETA Wed 10:30am PT. After upload, request 30-min joint review with legal + csm.
emma: Slot request noted. @design-bot create task and calendar invite for review.
design-bot: Task created: FIGMA-5050 "messaging-matrix-lottie-pack". Owners: @priya, @josh. Due 2025-05-22. Review meeting scheduled Wed 11:00am PT (30 min).
priya: Will include an accessibility README and a tiny QA checklist (contrast, alt text, copy accuracy, CSV validation).
josh: I'll push the copy CSV with 3 headline variants per tile + 2 CTA variants. Will mark one-line methodology for footer.
emma: Thanks team  this pack feeds webinar slides, social, and inbound flows. Keep modules interchangeable for quick swaps during live reviews. Ping when first pass is uploaded. :rocket:
